newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shorts softer in late trade, T-bills snapped.
newsitem.headline: Greek shorts softer in late trade, T-bills snapped.

text.p: The Bank of Greece injected overnight cash at 13.40 percent and provided further help via an overnight repo driving Greek short rates lower amid a persisting money squeeze on good T-bill sales approaching 1.0 trillion drachmas, dealers said.
About 100 million ecus were sold at the central bank's fixing, traders said.

"Overnight and tomnext are softer but still high," said a money trader at a state bank. "Today's overnight intervention was more effective because banks with bigger overnight facilities with the Bank of Greece were in a position to borrow more heavily than Monday."
T-bill sales including a 300 billion drachma private placement were approaching one trillion drachmas, a governemnt source told Reuters.
Earlier a monetary source told Reuters that total T-bill sales were about 942 billion drachmas.
A finance ministry official attributed the impressive T-bill sales to press reports of a withholding tax on state securities over the weekend.
But dealers said half of the amount was done by London-based banks.
Greece issued three-, six- and 12-month T-bills at unchanged yields of 11.90, 12.10 and 12.70 percent respectively on Monday.
The treasury also privately placed FRNs with a few local banks last week.
The state had collected about 60 billion drachmas from the sale of three-and six-month T-bills expiring October 1.
The mark was quoted at 157.94/99 drachmas from Tuesday's 158.000 fix, the dollar at 240.68/78 drachmas from 240.820 and the Ecu at 300.98/08 from 301.070 drachmas.
"Inflows of 100 million ecus took place at the fixing," said a trader. "Ecu/drachma is trading around 301."
The National Bank of Greece, the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 13.40-14.00
** One week at 13.10-13.60
** Two weeks at 12.80-13.30
** Three weeks at 12.60-13.10
** One month at 12.55-13.05
** Two months at 12.55-13.05
** Three months at 12.55-13.05
** Six months at 12.55-13.05
** Nine months at 12.70-13.20
** Twelve months at 12.85-13.35
